MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "Heat shrink tubing fits my breadboard, relay, and PCB work because it helps insulate connections when I assemble wired projects.",
    "The smaller solder seal connector pack feels useful for securing permanent wire joints without committing to a very large supply."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Oil, glue, and epoxy would need a specific maintenance or repair task to be useful to me now; my past projects alone do not create that need.",
    "The inspection camera, large magnets, and step drill bits involve tasks I have not shown a need for, such as inspecting confined spaces or drilling metal enclosures.",
    "The 1080-piece connector kit fits my wiring interests, but its quantity exceeds my current needs, so I would choose the smaller pack."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in hands-on electronics seems to have been stretched into an interest in almost any workshop supply.",
    "My caster-wheel purchase seems to have been given more meaning as a general mechanical-project interest than my other purchases support."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "Several of my purchases involve small electronic assemblies, so supplies that directly help connect and insulate wires have a clearer purpose for me.",
    "A relevant product still needs to fit the scale of my projects; a large assortment of connectors is less appealing than a manageable pack.",
    "I choose occasional-use tools and repair supplies when a concrete task calls for them, rather than simply because they might be useful someday."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my wiring interests but extended them too broadly into workshop supplies without a clear current use."
}
